key.name: panel-position
key.description: Place the indicator on the left, in the center or on the right of the top bar.

key.name: show-outdated
key.description: Show the out-of-date counter and check Arch GitLab on Arch-based systems. Ignored on other distributions.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to query package updates and supported out-of-date reports.
